rows.en:
(Maybe I'll do some solo training
in the schoolyard today.)

\p.
Training on your own?

Yes, Sensei!
I thought I'd work on perfecting
the running form you taught me.
I see.
rows.notes: x4: Yamashiro here and in the Christmas scene.

rows.en: Then I'll watch you from here.

Hm, your arm swing has improved a lot.
And your knees are coming up higher now.
rows.notes: momo (thighs) rendered as knees coming up, the usual English for the drill.

rows.en: You've clearly been putting in the miles.
I-it's nothing that impressive.

No need to be modest.
Your running is backed by real effort.
Th-thank you very much.
rows.notes: x9: player in several scenes and Shirakawa in frd_myk_001; neutral.

rows.en:
It's not much of a reward, but
I'll treat you to lunch. Follow me.

(Today I'm training in the schoolyard
with Yamashiro-sensei.)

Yes, Sensei!
I'm off to run, so please check my form.
rows.notes: Both genders; answers '\p. Sorry to keep you waiting.'

rows.en: Make sure you stretch properly before you run!

...Aren't you a bit worn out?
Your footwork is worse than last time.
Hmm, you think so...?

Running yourself ragged won't make you
any better. Go home and rest today.

Don't go off and play.
Go home and get some proper rest.

(Today I'm training in the schoolyard
with Yamashiro-sensei.)

You got here right on time,
\p.
Yeah, perfect timing.

Now then, how about we snack our way
around town today?

The hot dogs here are quite delicious.
The tang and heat of the chili sauce
are superb.
That spiciness really whets the appetite.
Still, don't overdo the spicy food.
Well then, shall we go somewhere else?
That spiciness really whets your appetite, huh?
I've been waiting for you, \p.
Today, let's take a look around the area.
I feel like we snack here every time.
Well, it's just so good...

I'd like to unravel the secret of
this addictive flavor someday...

Sorry to keep you waiting!
I ran a little late...

I got tired of waiting,
\p.
Sorry, I'm a little late!
Anyway, your swimsuit's as daring as ever...
rows.notes: Both genders; the player comments on Yamashiro's swimsuit (he replies 'Seems normal to me').

rows.en: Seems normal to me...
Never mind. Let's go!!
Swimming in the sea really is nice.

You float so easily,
and the rhythm of the waves feels great.
rows.notes: Both genders; generic 'you' for the dropped subject.

rows.en: Then let's swim a bit more!

(I'm at the artificial island with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
No, I'm in the same boat.
rows.notes: Both genders; answers 'Sorry to keep you waiting, \p'. otagaisama: read as the player being late too.

rows.en: We can deal with the bags later.

Now, I'll be sunbathing for a while today.
If you want to swim, go on your own.
Okay, I'll go swim for a bit!

If you want to hit on someone,
do it where I can't see.
rows.notes: Male version: nanpa, target left neutral.

rows.en: I-I won't!

(I'm at the artificial island with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
Ah, I'll carry the bags for you.

If you want to hit on guys,
do it where I can't see.
rows.notes: Female version: gyaku-nanpa (a girl picking up guys).

rows.en:
(After school at long last!
What should I do today?)
What's the matter, \p?
Hm? Oh, Yuuto.

Is something bothering you?
I'm happy to hear you out, if I'll do...
Nah, it's nothing that serious, really...

That can't be true, right?
You had a really troubled look on your face.
No, really. Calling it a worry is overblown...

Brushing it off like that makes for
a lonely life, though.
Come on, enjoy your youth a little more!
rows.notes: Both genders. seishun shitokou: 'let's do youth more'.

rows.en:
Well, see, I was just thinking about
how to spend my time after school.
I see. I jumped to conclusions, then.
Nah, it's no big deal.
So, what are you going to do?

Come on, let's figure out a worthwhile
way to spend our time after school.
Huh?! Why?

Helping out a friend who's troubled.
That's what friends are for, right?
Friends...
Right?
Yeah, I guess you're right.

Let's see... For the record, I'd like to
have some tea at a cafe.
Yeah, sounds good.
Then let's go together.

Phew. Having tea and talking about
all sorts of things really is relaxing.

Well, it's getting late, so let's head home.
Anyway, if anything comes up, come talk to me.
Yeah, see you.
(Yuuto's kind of an interesting guy.)

(It's finally after school.
What should I do today~?)
Huh? Kagura-kun?

Is something bothering you?
I'm happy to hear you out, if I'll do...
Then again, if it's a girl's problem...
rows.notes: Female version; continues into c06845 (he suggests asking Shirakawa).

rows.en: I'm not really worried about anything, though...

uncertain: c06807: otagai-sama ('it's mutual') answering Yamashiro's 'Sorry to keep you waiting': read as the player being late too ('I'm in the same boat').
c06811: nanpa in the male version rendered 'hit on someone' (target not stated); c06815 gyaku-nanpa in the female version is explicitly a girl picking up guys.
c06800: kiwadoi mizugi ('risque swimsuit') read as the player commenting on Yamashiro's swimsuit, since he answers that it seems normal.
